title.zh: v2.0.24 通道条动态扩充（支持 24/32 轨并入混音链）、子引擎（大师课与底鼓解剖）限幅器保护与移动端导航补齐
title.en: v2.0.24 Dynamic channel strip expansion (24/32-track mixing chain support), sub-engine limiter protection (Masterclass & Kick Anatomy) and mobile drawer navigation completion

highlights.zh: **通道条动态按需扩充**：针对 CompareView 24 轨与 32 轨复杂工程，`AudioEngine` 的通道条分配机制由原本写死的 16 轨动态扩充至 `Math.max(16, pattern.tracks.length)`。`setPattern` 切换大型工程时自动扩容补全缺失通道条并保证插入效果链与声像节点正确建立，彻底修复之前超过 16 轨的伴奏与对比轨道绕过通道条混音链路的问题。
highlights.en: **Dynamic channel strip allocation**: Expanded `AudioEngine` channel strips from hardcoded 16 to dynamically allocate `Math.max(16, pattern.tracks.length)` to support CompareView's 24 and 32-track projects. Switching patterns dynamically expands missing strips and attaches their insert effects and panners, resolving the previous issue where tracks past strip 16 bypassed channel strip processing.

highlights.zh: **子引擎限幅保护**：为独立运行的 `MasterclassAudioEngine`（调音大师课音频引擎）与 `AnatomyKickEngine`（底鼓解剖引擎）接入 `MasterLimiter` 动态限幅防护链路，并在销毁时显式释放限幅器与音频上下文，彻底杜绝大师课多轨示范与多层底鼓合成测试中的数字破音与削波失真风险。
highlights.en: **Sub-engine limiter protection**: Wired `MasterLimiter` dynamically to `MasterclassAudioEngine` and `AnatomyKickEngine` to guard against digital clipping during multi-track demonstrations and layered kick synthesis, and properly disposed resources in `destroy()`.

highlights.zh: **移动端抽屉导航补全**：在顶部导航栏（`Header.tsx`）的移动端折叠抽屉菜单中，补齐了遗漏的「调音台」（`/console`）、「全景声谱分析仪」（`/analyzer`）与「曲风制作工坊」（`/maker`）快捷路由跳转，移动端体验与桌面端保持完全一致。
highlights.en: **Mobile drawer navigation complete**: Added missing routes for Console (`/console`), Spectral Analyzer (`/analyzer`), and Genre Maker (`/maker`) to the mobile slide-out drawer menu in `Header.tsx`.
